To create a clean architecture for your REST client in Delphi FMX, you can use the following approach:

1. Create a main form for the application that will serve as the entry point for the user.
2. Create a separate component for each view, such as a tree view, list view, and table view.
3. Use a routing component to handle the different endpoints and sub-endpoints. This component will listen to events from the user, such as clicking on a tree view item, and will change the current view accordingly.
4. Use a view manager component to manage the different views and switch between them. The view manager component will be responsible for creating and destroying the different views as needed.
5. Use a toolbar component to display the current view and provide access to the search function, as well as other tools that the user may need. The toolbar can be docked to the main form or added as a separate component.
6. Use a frame component to add a layer of complexity to the application, if needed. The frame component can be used to group related components together and make them easier to manage.
